items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: He used to ride Higgy so bad it would make him cry and that was in the Luis Russell band.

ctx.x: We had a feud going, he and I.
I remember Greeley telling me how he used to ride Higgy all the time. He used to ride Higgy so bad it would make him cry and that was in the Luis Russell band.
But I was in the Luis Russell band too.
